statements.qualification: Corrected: saved text is capped at the site's 50 KB serialized per-entry limit; larger input is not saved and an earlier saved entry remains. GA4 also collects default page/device/session parameters, so the answer now names the tool's custom event parameters (tool_name, tool_action). 'SHA fingerprints' because MD5 is computed by the page's own JS, not Web Crypto. Deduplication compares only the last tracked PEM list, so an A→B→A sequence records A again; 'unchanged chain' is true for an immediately repeated unchanged chain.
